note: Release history for the Piano Player desktop app. This file records milestone updates and major feature changes.

versions.changelog: Features added: import/export, playback controls, optimisations, a few more
Critical update! Fixes the auto updater (if it doesn't work, download from the github or go to this website: https://github.com/Paryx-games/sheet-player/releases/download/v1.2.0/PianoPlayer.exe
PySide6 migration and premium UI refresh: more polished dark interface, improved sheet editor, and smoother playback controls while preserving the core piano automation workflow.
Installer-based auto-update: the app now downloads the new installer, silently removes the old install, and launches the upgraded version cleanly. Also overhauled the UI a bunch.
Added midi support, per sheet tempo and per sheet settings, performance optimisations (multi threading).
